title: The 10 Best Shower Curtains
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for shower curtains, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at shower curtains using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: iDesign Fabric Shower Curtain, Long 72-Inch by 84-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: Woven polyester construction, Extra-long 72 x 84-inch sizing, Reinforced buttonholes.
strengths: Extra-long 84-inch drop fits high rod mounts without leaving a gap above the tub
Reinforced buttonholes hold up to years of daily hook friction better than unreinforced punched holes
Drapes naturally and machine washes without cracking, unlike vinyl
limitations: Does not block water on its own, requires a separate PEVA or vinyl liner
Absorbs moisture and dries slower than any plastic curtain in this guide
84-inch length is oversized and pools on the floor for standard 8-foot ceiling installs

products.name: InterDesign 26680 Clear Vinyl Shower Curtain 72 x 72 Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: Clear PVC vinyl construction, Fully waterproof, single-layer use, 72 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Lowest-cost path to a single-purchase, fully waterproof setup, no separate liner needed
Wipes clean in seconds and dries fast between showers
Clear design lets light through, useful in a windowless or small bathroom
limitations: New-vinyl odor is noticeable for the first several days out of the package
Sticks to skin and clings more during a hot shower than fabric or PEVA
Cracks at fold lines and grommets sooner than a fabric curtain paired with a separate liner lasts

products.name: iDesign Fabric Shower Curtain, Mildew-Resistant, Tan
products.blurb: Key specs: Antimicrobial silver-ion fabric treatment, Woven polyester construction, 72 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Treated fabric resists the musty odor buildup untreated polyester develops within a few months
Same drape and machine-washable convenience as untreated fabric, with the added mildew resistance
Works well as the decorative outer layer over a plastic liner in a daily-use bathroom
limitations: Still requires a separate waterproof liner, the treatment resists mildew, it does not block water
Antimicrobial treatment loses effectiveness gradually over repeated washing
Tan colorway shows soap scum and water spotting more visibly than darker prints

products.name: Zenna Home Waterproof Fabric Shower Curtain or Liner, White
products.blurb: Key specs: Water-repellent coated fabric, Usable as a standalone curtain or liner, 70 x 72-inch fit.
strengths: Functions as both the water barrier and the visible layer, eliminating the need for a second plastic liner
Water-repellent coating sheds water rather than absorbing it, unlike untreated fabric
Simplifies a two-layer setup into one purchase for anyone who wants fabric feel without extra pieces
Machine washable without the cracking risk vinyl liners carry
limitations: Water-repellent coating wears down faster than PEVA or vinyl's inherent waterproofing, typically within a year of regular washing
Not as fully waterproof as a dedicated PEVA or vinyl liner for a long, hot daily shower
Lower rating count (5,400) than the top fabric and liner picks in this guide
features: Usable as a standalone curtain or liner

products.name: Zenna Home Heavyweight Shower Curtain Liner, 8-Gauge EVA
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-gauge EVA thickness, Weighted hem, Rustproof grommets.
strengths: 8-gauge thickness resists billowing and the creasing that traps moisture in folds
Weighted hem keeps the bottom pinned against the tub wall during a hot shower
Highest rating count of any pick in this guide (12,300+), the strongest durability track record
Holds up to weekly cold washing without cracking, longer-lived than thinner PEVA liners
limitations: Heavier and stiffer to hang and fold than lighter-gauge liners
Costs more per unit than 3G or 4G PEVA liners
Takes longer to fully air dry given the added thickness

products.name: Zenna Home Ultimate Striped Waterproof Fabric Shower Curtain, Grey
products.blurb: Key specs: Woven striped polyester construction, Water-repellent waterproof finish, 72 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Striped weave adds texture that plain solid-color fabric curtains lack, without moving to a printed pattern
Waterproof coating lets it double as a light-duty liner in a guest bathroom
Grey stripe pattern hides soap scum and water spotting better than white or light solids
Machine washable without the cracking risk that comes with vinyl
limitations: Water-repellent coating is not as durable long-term as a dedicated PEVA or vinyl liner
Lowest rating count (3,100) of the fabric options in this guide
Standard 72 x 72 sizing does not suit high rod mounts or extra-long tubs

products.name: Splash Home Prisma Design Polyester Shower Curtain
products.blurb: Key specs: Printed geometric prisma design, 100% polyester fabric, 70 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Colorful geometric print gives more visual interest than the solid-tone iDesign and Zenna fabric options
Metal grommets outlast the plastic grommets found on similarly priced printed curtains
Standard 70 x 72 fit works for the vast majority of tub and shower openings without alteration
Affordable way to add a statement pattern to a bathroom without paying designer-brand pricing
limitations: Does not block water on its own, needs a separate liner behind it
Bold print shows fading from repeated washing sooner than a solid color would
Lowest rating count (2,200) among the fabric curtains in this guide

products.name: Splash Home Pearl Tree PEVA 4G Premium Plastic Shower Liner
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-gauge PEVA construction, Chlorine-free, low-odor material, Fully waterproof, single-layer use.
strengths: Lowest odor out of the box of any waterproof option in this guide, since PEVA skips the PVC chemical smell
Cheapest fully waterproof, single-layer option available here
Lightweight and easy to hang or swap compared to heavier vinyl liners
Pearl-tree pattern adds visual texture that a plain clear vinyl liner lacks
limitations: 4-gauge thickness billows more in shower airflow than a 6G or 8G liner
Tears at the grommet holes sooner than vinyl or the 8-gauge EVA liner in this guide
Typically needs replacement within 6 to 9 months of daily use, sooner than a heavier liner

products.name: Carnation Home Fashions The Starry Night Fabric Shower Curtain
products.blurb: Key specs: Printed starry-night pattern, 100% polyester fabric, 70 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Detailed art-inspired print stands out more than the geometric or striped prints elsewhere in this guide
Reinforced buttonholes hold up to daily hook use without tearing
Works well layered over a plain PEVA or vinyl liner for a bathroom that wants a focal-point curtain
limitations: Does not block water, requires a separate liner
Lowest rating count (1,900) of any pick in this guide, a thinner track record than the higher-volume options
Detailed print is more prone to visible fading over repeated washes than a solid or striped design

products.name: Carnation Home Fashions Shower Curtain, South Beach Blue
products.blurb: Key specs: Coastal-print polyester fabric, 70 x 72-inch standard fit, Rustproof grommets.
strengths: Coastal blue palette fits beach-house or nautical-themed bathrooms without needing separate decor coordination
Reinforced top hem resists sagging and tearing at the hook points better than a single-layer hem
Standard 70 x 72 sizing fits the majority of tub and shower openings out of the box
Machine washable without cracking, unlike vinyl or PEVA alternatives
limitations: Does not block water on its own, needs a separate waterproof liner behind it
Lowest rating count (1,500) of any pick in this guide, the thinnest track record here
Coastal print styling limits it to bathrooms already leaning into that theme

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
